entities.summary: Joseph Hinman Wieskamp is an American professional basketball player for Science City Jena of the German Basketball Bundesliga (BBL). He played college basketball for the Iowa Hawkeyes before being drafted 41st overall in the 2021 NBA draft by the San Antonio Spurs.
